body: This is a film about true friendship, Argentinian style. In my country friendship is some kind of religión we all profess. So we feel touched by the situations in this film. Another good reason to watch it is enjoy the actors' great work. Impressive, even when we know they are among the best actors of Argentina. Great movie! go watch it.

First, a realistic portrait and touching eulogy of friendship. Second - admirable work of Luis Brandoni and Guillermo Francella. Not the last - the healthy humor. Short, just the comedy who you must see. Not only for story/situations/ characters but for the precise lessons about beauty, joy and profound comradery. And, sure, about a too , very honest ONG activist.

Guillermo Francella and Luis Brandoni deliver a high quality performance and form a memorable duo. Moreover, the film is generally successful even if the scenario is sometimes perfectible, with 2/3 insufficiently credible transitions . But this remains secondary. I loved it!

Very amusing all the way through. Guillermo Francella was also in The Secret in Their Eyes (the Argentinian version), where he displayed the exact same dead-pan humor playing as Pablo Sandoval. In fact the whole movie seemed to be written for his style of humor (tongue-in-cheek).
Never disappointed of Argentinian movies, like always. Amazing movie.
